proposals.before: That month Jiujiang suffered great famine; one in fourteen or fifteen people ate human flesh.
proposals.after: That month Jiujiang suffered great famine; four or five out of ten people ate human flesh.
proposals.reason: Classical 十四五 here means roughly four or five tenths (40–50%), not one in fourteen or fifteen.

proposals.before: That month Prince Lun of Shaoling came from Xunyang to Xiakou; Jingzhou inspector Prince Ke of Nanping yielded the province to him.
proposals.after: That month Prince Lun of Shaoling came from Xunyang to Xiakou; Yingzhou inspector Prince Ke of Nanping yielded the province to him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 郢州刺史 is Yingzhou inspector, not Jingzhou (荊州).

proposals.before: On jiawu in the eighth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Army Inspector General Wang Senbian with troops to press Yingzhou.
proposals.after: On jiawu in the eighth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Army Inspector General Wang Sengbian with troops to press Yingzhou.
proposals.reason: 王僧辯 is conventionally Sengbian; Senbian is a mistranscription of 僧.

proposals.before: On guwei in the fifth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong urgently sent mobile corps general Hu Sengyou and Xin province inspector Lu Fahe to relieve Baling; Hou Jing sent Ren Yue with an army to block them.
proposals.after: On guwei in the fifth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent mobile corps general Hu Sengyou and Xin province inspector Lu Fahe to relieve Baling; Hou Jing sent Ren Yue with an army to block them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 湘東王驛遣 is a corruption of 湘東王繹遣; 驛 is not an adverb 'urgently'.

proposals.before: Western Wei raided Anlu, seized Sizhou Inspector Liu Zhongli, and wholly lost the lands east of the Han.
proposals.after: Western Wei raided Anlu, seized Sizhou Inspector Liu Zhongli, and wholly took the lands east of the Han.
proposals.reason: 盡沒漢東之地 means the lands east of the Han were entirely lost/taken; literal 'wholly lost' with Western Wei as subject reverses the sense.

decisions.reason: s0048’s famine formula 人相食十四五 uses 十四五 as four or five tenths (什四五), the standard dynastic proportion, not one person in fourteen or fifteen; the replacement restores that sense.
s0082 has 郢州刺史; 郢州 is Yingzhou, distinct from Jingzhou (荊州), so the replacement corrects the province name without other change.
s0090 names 王僧辯; 僧 is Seng, and Sengbian is the conventional romanization, so Senbian is a mistranscription of that syllable.

Chapter s0106’s 湘東王驛遣 is a graphic corruption of 湘東王繹遣; 驛 is not an urgency adverb. Liangshu juan 5’s parallel for the same relief of Baling is simply 世祖遣, confirming Prince Yi sent the force without ‘urgently’.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 五月癸未，世祖遣游擊將軍胡僧祐、信州刺史陸法和帥衆下援巴陵

decisions.reason: In s0071 Western Wei is the subject of 寇…執…盡沒; 沒 here means the lands east of the Han were wholly taken/annexed, so ‘wholly lost’ reverses the agent’s action.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows English Senbian came only from the bad romanization of 僧辯; the personal-name claim’s en value must read Sengbian.
